name: ai-agent-bell
description: AI Agent Bell: a loud alarm when your AI coding agent finishes, fails, or needs your input. Works with OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI and any terminal tool. Global-only: zero project impact, never ships in your build. Local-only: no network, no usage tracking, zero dependencies.
author: Hemant Rao

scripts.test: node --check bin/ai-agent-bell.js && node --check lib/alarm.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check index.mjs && node --check detectors/index.js && node --check detectors/completion.js && node --check detectors/input-required.js && node --check detectors/error.js && node --check detectors/warning.js && node --check notifications/sound.js && node --check notifications/desktop.js && node --check notifications/terminal.js && node --input-type=module --check < adapters/opencode-plugin.js && node --check tools/verify-opencode.js && node --check tools/ring-check.js && node tests/smoke.js
